learned.description: Injects max_tasks, max_hours, and task_timeout guardrails into hive config and respawns session to prevent unbounded retries and enforce controlled shutdown.
learned.example: grep -q '^max_tasks=' ~/.hive/config || echo 'max_tasks=1000' >> ~/.hive/config && grep -q '^max_hours=' ~/.hive/config || echo 'max_hours=48' >> ~/.hive/config && grep -q '^task_timeout=' ~/.hive/config || echo 'task_timeout=7200' >> ~/.hive/config && tmux respawn-window -t SESSION

learned.description: Detects and force-clears port collisions then verifies bind before respawning dependent tmux windows.
learned.example: ss -tlnp | grep PORT && lsof -ti:PORT | xargs -r kill -9; sleep 1; python3 -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1); s.bind(('', PORT)); print('bind ok'); s.close()" && tmux respawn-window -t SESSION

learned.description: Safely injects missing config keys and applies them via window respawn to avoid stale state.
learned.example: grep -q task_timeout ~/.hive/config || echo 'task_timeout=7200' >> ~/.hive/config && tmux respawn-window -t SESSION

Immediate focus is on adding retry/backoff for flaky LLM calls, forbidden-path unit tests, per-session SLO backpressure, and a /api/metrics endpoint to drive UI-based throttling decisions.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Deployed Next.js UI on port 3001 with GitHub auth and SSE streams; added port-conflict resolution and config-default-apply capabilities.
next_steps: Add exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to call_llm() in orchestrator.py handling HTTP 429/404 and SSL handshake timeouts with configurable max_retries.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns (absolute paths, parent traversal, device files, symlink escapes) with parametrized cases.
Add /api/metrics endpoint to pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats, load/core, mem, disk percentages, and per-session SLO breach flags.
Add exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() on network errors and HTTP 5xx with capped attempts and readable error mapping.
Define per-session SLOs and backpressure rules in config/slos.json and implement enforceSLO() in supervisor/supervisor.ts to pause/resume sessions when CPU>80% or mem>90%.
decisions: Adopt exponential backoff with full jitter for all external LLM/HTTP calls to reduce 429/timeout cascades.
Gate session execution via enforceSLO() using real-time CPU/mem/disk metrics from /api/metrics to prevent research_loop pauses.
Fail-closed in org_guard.py: any forbidden path match immediately denies and logs with traceable violation codes.

orchestrator_sessions.goal: Stabilize hive load and complete telemetry surface to resume paused research loops while hardening LLM call resilience.
orchestrator_sessions.summary: The hive runs healthy with 9 active sessions and strong UI coverage, but core/memory pressure has paused research loops and SSL/HTTP errors are blocking LLM diagnostics. A new text model is promoted and Next.js UI is live, but retry, metrics, and guardrail coverage need immediate codebase fixes to restore throughput.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff and jitter to lib/sse.ts sendStream() and wired it into the SSE stream for stable event delivery under load.
next_steps: Add retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter to call_llm() in orchestrator.py handling HTTP 429/404 and SSL handshake timeouts with configurable max_retries and backoff_factor.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns including '..', '/etc/', 'proc/', and symlink escapes with both allowlist and denylist modes.
Implement /api/metrics endpoint in pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats (active, paused, cpu_pct, mem_bytes, disk_pct) from the supervisor state store.
Define per-session SLOs and backpressure rules in config/slos.json and integrate checks into supervisor to pause sessions when core>1.5 or mem>24GB, and resume below thresholds.
Add SSL context tuning and timeout defaults in lib/http_client.py to harden TLS handshakes (increase handshake timeout to 30s, enable session reuse, and set safe cipher list).
decisions: Hardcode call_llm() retries to max 5 with exponential backoff (initial 1s, factor 2) and jitter to break thundering herds on 429/404/timeouts.
Adopt a deny-first guardrail in org_guard.py with strict path normalization and realpath resolution to prevent directory traversal and symlink escapes.
Expose /api/metrics as the single source of truth for session health used by the UI and autoscaler, with cache TTL 5s and supervisor state ownership.

orchestrator_sessions.goal: Stabilize overloaded sessions and harden hive-ui against transient LLM/network failures while surfacing live metrics.
orchestrator_sessions.summary: The hive is running hot (core=1.57–1.74, mem=24.1GB) with research_loop paused and multiple LLM call timeouts/429s. Next.js UI is live on port 3001 with 12 routes and SSE streaming. Immediate focus is on retry/backoff for LLM calls, metrics endpoint, and per-session SLO enforcement to resume research_loop.
orchestrator_sessions.progress: Added exponential backoff with jitter and idempotency-key support to call_llm() in orchestrator.py and wired retries for HTTP 429/5xx plus SSL handshake timeouts with capped attempts.
next_steps: Add /api/metrics endpoint to pages/api/metrics.ts returning JSON of session stats (active counts, load/core/mem/disk, paused flags, error rates) with 5s cache-control.
Write unit tests for org_guard.py covering all forbidden path patterns (../../, /etc, /proc, /home/*/.ssh, /var/run/docker.sock) asserting raises on violation.
Add exponential backoff and jitter retry logic to lib/sse.ts sendStream() for network/5xx failures with maxAttempts=5 and a readable AbortController signal.
Define per-session SLOs and backpressure rules in config/slos.json and wire supervisor to throttle/pause sessions when CPU>80% or mem>20GB; expose thresholds via /api/metrics.
Add circuit-breaker wrapper around call_llm() in orchestrator.py: open after 5 consecutive failures, half-open after 30s, close after 3 successes, and log state transitions.
decisions: Cap call_llm() retries to 3 with exponential backoff (base 1s, factor 2, jitter ±25%) and fail fast to avoid compounding load during outages.
Expose per-session SLO thresholds and current usage in /api/metrics to enable UI-driven backpressure and autoscaling decisions.
Enforce org_guard.py path checks on every write/exec intent and default-deny any traversal or system-device paths to harden the hive.
